So this report seeks approval to remove previously established restricted covenants
within Saskatoon land development areas.
Prior to 2016, the city established restricted covenants on development, which sets strict
guidelines on certain architectural and design elements.
Over time, development and architectural trends change, and as a result, the standards
enforced by these restricted covenants may become less desired and become an obstacle
for new developments.
Saskatoon land no longer registers restricted covenants on titles, and instead uses an administrative
review and approval process to regulate architectural elements.
This architectural review and approval process has proven to be successful and provides
greater flexibility over time as markets and development trends evolve.
The recommendation is to proceed with the administrative review and approval process
for all previously established covenants prior to 2016.
